title: Alibaba Launches 2.4 Trillion-Parameter Large Model Open Source, Performance Rivals Fable 5

content_html:
Recently, the open-source field has made significant progress. The Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B model weights have been officially released by the Qwen large model team at Alibaba. This is also the first time that the team has fully opened its flagship Max-level model to developers and researchers around the world.

As the core of this open source, the model has a total parameter count of 2.4 trillion, with 95 billion parameters activated per token. It natively supports an ultra-long context of 260,000 tokens and can be further expanded to 1,010,000 tokens. Its underlying architecture continues the advantages of Qwen3.5, achieving comprehensive performance improvements in programming, daily office work, research assistance, and long-term intelligent agent tasks.

In various authoritative benchmark tests, the model has shown outstanding performance. Its results rank among the top models in the PaperBench paper reproduction benchmark and the OSWorld-Verified computer operation capability evaluation. In some indicators, it even surpasses several international mainstream models. In addition, its strong long-term autonomous working capabilities are remarkable, as it can independently complete complex programming tasks lasting several days and autonomously reproduce and optimize research papers.

content_html_zh:
最近，开源领域取得了重大进展。 阿里巴巴Qwen大模型团队正式发布了Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B模型权重。 这也是该团队首次向全球开发者和研究人员全面开放其旗舰Max-level模型。

作为本次开源的核心，该模型的参数总数达到 2.4 万亿个，每个代币激活的参数达到 950 亿个。 它原生支持260,000个token的超长上下文，并且可以进一步扩展到1,010,000个token。 其底层架构延续了Qwen3.5的优势，在编程、日常办公、科研辅助、长期智能代理任务等方面实现了全面的性能提升。

在各种权威基准测试中，该模型都表现出了出色的表现。 其成绩在PaperBench论文复制基准和OSWorld-Verified计算机运算能力评估中均名列前茅。 在某些指标上甚至超过了几款国际主流车型。 此外，其强大的长期自主工作能力令人瞩目，可以独立完成持续数天的复杂编程任务，并自主复制和优化研究论文。
